prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go using package solution.
Required API: func DecodeHex(text string) ([]byte, bool)
Behavior: Decode pairs of ASCII hexadecimal digits, accepting upper or lower case. Reject odd length, non-ASCII, or any non-hex digit; empty input succeeds with an empty byte sequence.
Visible example: "4A00ff" produces bytes [74, 0, 255].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution

func DecodeHex(s string)([]byte,bool){if len(s)%2!=0{return nil,false};out:=make([]byte,len(s)/2);hex:=func(c byte)(byte,bool){switch{case c>='0'&&c<='9':return c-'0',true;case c>='a'&&c<='f':return c-'a'+10,true;case c>='A'&&c<='F':return c-'A'+10,true};return 0,false};for i:=range out{a,ok:=hex(s[2*i]);if !ok{return nil,false};b,ok:=hex(s[2*i+1]);if !ok{return nil,false};out[i]=a*16+b};return out,true}
